title: A citizen panel
bodyMd: A city selects residents by lottery for a panel discussing park opening hours. The invitation is random, but participation is voluntary. A researcher warns that the final panel may overrepresent people with flexible schedules. The city offers childcare and evening meetings to reduce barriers. It does not claim these measures eliminate every source of nonparticipation.
